description: Swap USDC or USDT0 on Arbitrum into BTC over Lightning or to an Ark address (Satora; about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee, shown in the quote). REAL MONEY. Gasless: no wallet or ETH needed. Without confirm: preview only. With confirm: creates the swap, checks it, and returns deposit.address, the exact amount and the token: send that once (one ERC-20 transfer on Arbitrum One), then call swap_fund with wait=true. Never send twice

address.description: to=arkade: an Ark address from an Arkade wallet on https://arkade.computer (with amount). Lightning addresses are not supported

amount.description: to=arkade (or a Lightning quote without an invoice): token amount to send, like "1.5" (fees come out of it)

confirm.description: must be true to create the real swap; omit to preview

from.description: the stablecoin you send, on Arbitrum One

invoice.description: to=lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount; Satora pays exactly it (required to create; no amount)

to.description: how the BTC is paid out (default lightning)

name: swap_to_btc_create
